REMARKS:

012200Z POSITION NEAR 19.4N 109.6W.

01OCT26. HURRICANE 18E (RACHEL), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 899 NM

SOUTH-SOUTHEAST OF SAN DIEGO, HAS TRACKED WESTWARD AT 02 KNOTS

OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS.

MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 011800Z IS 955 MB. MAXIMUM

SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 011800Z IS 32 FEET. NEXT WARNINGS AT

020400Z, 021000Z, 021600Z AND 022200Z.

REFER TO TROPICAL STORM 15E (NOLO) WARNINGS (WTPN33 PHNC)

FOR SIX-HOURLY UPDATES.

REFER TO REMNANTS OF 19E (NINETEEN) WARNINGS (WTPN31 PHNC).//
